CP01.easy:
# Conveyor Meal Assembly

## Capability dimension

Mind2Act — Multi-step tasks that couple memory or reasoning with physical manipulation.

## Description

Food arrives on a conveyor and 1 reference order is shown; the tray is already placed. The robot needs to fill one tray per order with exactly its three foods. A food counts when it is supported in the correct tray. Net correct = correct foods − wrong foods − extra foods.

## Scoring

| Score | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | No net correct food. |
| 5 | Net 1 food correct. |
| 10 | Net 2 foods correct. |
| 15 | All foods net correct, but the 100-point conditions are not all met. |
| 100 | Every tray holds exactly its order with no extra food, after all orders have been shown. |

CP02.easy:
# Rotating Cake Decoration

## Capability dimension

Mind2Act — Multi-step tasks that couple memory or reasoning with physical manipulation.

## Description

The still cake with its macarons is shown for three seconds; remember each macaron and its place. Then the cake rotates. The robot needs to place 4 macarons, each supported by the cake with its centre inside its target circle. Net correct = correct macarons − wrong macarons − extra macarons.

## Scoring

| Score | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | No net correct macaron. |
| 3.75 | Net 1 macaron correct. |
| 7.5 | Net 2 macarons correct. |
| 11.25 | Net 3 macarons correct. |
| 15 | All macarons net correct, but the 100-point conditions are not all met. |
| 100 | After the target display ends, every macaron is placed on the rotating cake, all correct with no extra. |

CP03.easy:
# Dish Rack Loading

## Capability dimension

Mind2Act — Multi-step tasks that couple memory or reasoning with physical manipulation.

## Description

The lever is preset. Press the green button (START); the rack starts moving. The robot needs to take 3 plates from the source rack and load each into a correct empty slot while the rack moves. A plate counts when the gripper carried it from the source rack, it entered while the rack was moving, and it ends supported in a correct empty slot. Net correct = correct plates − wrong plates − extra plates.

## Scoring

| Score | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | No net correct plate. |
| 5 | Net 1 plate correct. |
| 10 | Net 2 plates correct. |
| 15 | All plates net correct, but the 100-point conditions are not all met. |
| 100 | START pressed, and every plate correctly loaded. |

CP04.easy:
# Cooking

## Capability dimension

Mind2Act — Multi-step tasks that couple memory or reasoning with physical manipulation.

## Description

The recipe is shown on the screen at the start, then hidden. The robot needs to uncap each of the 2 required jars and pour its whole portion into the pot in the remembered recipe order, return the jars to their slots and the caps to the tray, turn the knob to HEAT and press the green button, switch to KEEP WARM within 4 s after 80 °C, then turn it off. A wrong pour cannot be undone. Ingredients count as the longest part of your pours that matches the recipe order.

## Scoring

| Score | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | No ingredient poured in recipe order. |
| 7.5 | 1 ingredient poured in recipe order. |
| 15 | All ingredients poured in recipe order, but the 100-point conditions are not all met. |
| 100 | Every step correct. |

CP05.easy:
# Electronic Piano Replay

## Capability dimension

Mind2Act — Multi-step tasks that couple memory or reasoning with physical manipulation.

## Description

Pick up the central mallet, press the triangle-marked button (Play) and watch the demonstration while holding the mallet. Then the robot needs to replay the 8 demonstrated key presses in the same order and put the mallet back on the rack. A note counts when a key goes down at least 2 mm and comes back up to below 0.5 mm before the next press. Notes count as the longest part of your notes that matches the demonstration in order.

## Scoring

| Score | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | No note played in order. |
| 15 × 1/8 | 1 note played in the demonstrated order. |
| 3.75 | 2 notes played in the demonstrated order. |
| 15 × 3/8 | 3 notes played in the demonstrated order. |
| 7.5 | 4 notes played in the demonstrated order. |
| 15 × 5/8 | 5 notes played in the demonstrated order. |
| 11.25 | 6 notes played in the demonstrated order. |
| 15 × 7/8 | 7 notes played in the demonstrated order. |
| 15 | All notes in order, but the 100-point conditions are not all met. |
| 100 | Every note in order, no extra note, and the mallet back on the rack. |

CP10.easy:
# Ball Prediction and Blocker Return

## Capability dimension

Mind2Act — Multi-step tasks that couple memory or reasoning with physical manipulation.

## Description

After two practice balls, 5 scored balls are launched, 3 of them white. A ball's colour shows only after launch. The blocker is a paddle on a straight slide on the side near the nets; slide it along the rail into a ball's path. The robot needs to use it to return every white ball to the far net and let every red ball pass into the near net without touching the blocker. Do not touch a ball with the robot.

## Scoring

| Score | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | No white ball correct before the first wrong scored ball, or the robot touched a ball. |
| 5 | 1 white ball correct before the first wrong scored ball. |
| 10 | 2 white balls correct before the first wrong scored ball. |
| 15 | All white balls correct before the first wrong scored ball, but the 100-point conditions are not all met. |
| 100 | Every white ball hits the blocker and ends in the far net, every red ball ends in the near net without touching the blocker, and the robot never touches a ball. |

# Domino Chain

## Capability dimension

Act — Manipulation tasks with tight precision, timing, or dynamic constraints.

## Description

There are 5 dominos, a curved band and a bell. The robot needs to stand the dominos in order along the band and push the first one so that the chain falls and the last one hits the bell. Only the first domino may be pushed. If the chain stops partway, wait at least 3 s, stand the dominos back up, and push the first one again. At most 8 pushes in total. Do not touch the bell or a falling domino.

## Scoring

| Score | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | No complete chain, more than 8 pushes, a push on any domino other than the first, or the robot touched the bell or a falling domino. |
| 15 | A complete legal chain is set up. |
| 30 | The chain falls through at least the first 3 dominos. |
| 100 | All dominos fall and the last one hits the bell. |

# Carousel Colour Restoration

## Capability dimension

Mind — Tasks requiring memory, spatial reasoning, planning, or learning from feedback.

## Description

Four slots on a carousel show colour cues for one second, then the carousel rotates and changes direction. The robot needs to put each coloured block back into the slot that showed its colour.

## Scoring

| Score | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | 0 or 1 block in its original slot. |
| 7.5 | 2 blocks in their original slots. |
| 15 | 3 blocks in their original slots. |
| 100 | All 4 blocks in their original slots. |

# Forbidden-Cell Navigation

## Capability dimension

Mind — Tasks requiring memory, spatial reasoning, planning, or learning from feedback.

## Description

There is a 4 × 4 board with a slider and direction buttons. The robot needs to move the slider into the ring with the buttons without entering any forbidden cell and without leaving the board. Press one direction at a time; each press is one full press and release.

## Scoring

| Score | Condition |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | Otherwise. |
| 100 | The slider is in the ring and never entered a forbidden cell or left the board. |
